Read this sentence from the selection.

On its own, a colony of 100 frogs has little chance of long-term survival.

The author included this sentence most likely to show —

options.label: A
options.text: that the life span of the yellow-spotted bell frog is extremely short

options.label: B
options.text: why scientists are taking several different steps to protect the remaining yellow-spotted bell frogs

options.label: C
options.text: that the yellow-spotted bell frogs can live only in zoos

options.label: D
options.text: how scientists are trying to help the yellow-spotted bell frog by eliminating the chytrid fungus
